notes: `ʿaḏ kî` is read as one fused rendering of *until*, headed on the governing morpheme under rule 23; marking `kî` `unrepresented` was the competing reading.
*that day* writes one determiner, which the demonstrative `hûʾ` takes; the preposition, the assimilated article and the agreement article are all `unrepresented` (rules 40, 41, 47).
